zh.title: Air Serbia規劃2027年5月開通貝爾格勒至邁阿密直飛航線
zh.summary: Air Serbia規劃2027年5月開通貝爾格勒至邁阿密直飛航線，採用空中巴士A330
body: Air Serbia規劃於2027年5月開通貝爾格勒至邁阿密的直飛航班。Simple Flying的摘要指出，這項服務將使用空中巴士A330，並擴展Air Serbia的北美航網。這項航線安排指向未來開航，並非已開始營運的航班。
Simple Flying標題將這條航線稱為Air Serbia迄今最長的美國航線，並提及空中巴士A330。摘要所列的航線為貝爾格勒至邁阿密直飛，預定開航時間為2027年5月。

en.title: Air Serbia Plans Nonstop Belgrade–Miami Route for May 2027
en.summary: Air Serbia plans nonstop Belgrade–Miami flights in May 2027, using Airbus A330 aircraft.
body: Air Serbia plans to launch nonstop flights between Belgrade and Miami in May 2027, according to Simple Flying. The report's summary says the service will use Airbus A330 aircraft and expand Air Serbia's North American network. The headline characterizes it as Air Serbia's longest US route yet and also names the Airbus A330.

The planned launch month is May 2027, so the item describes a future service rather than an existing route. The route details stated in the summary are nonstop flights between Belgrade and Miami. Simple Flying's headline presents the route as Air Serbia's longest US route yet.

zh.title: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）重開，恢復有限度營運
zh.summary: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）重開，但國際航空公司仍維持航班停飛
body: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）於10月18日重新開放，此前因區域安全事件而關閉。Aerospace Global News報導，機場目前恢復有限度營運；報導提醒，重新開放不代表恢復正常營運，國際航空公司仍維持航班停飛。
報導指出，機場重開不保證每家航空公司都已恢復航班，已公佈的時刻表也未必維持；旅客仍可能遇上行程受阻，情況可能在短時間內變動。旅客應直接向實際營運航空公司確認航班，不應只依賴旅行社行程、機場出發資訊看板或較早收到的確認電子郵件。

en.title: Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport (RUH) Reopens With Limited Operations
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) has reopened, but international airlines continue flight suspensions.
body: Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport (RUH) reopened on 18 October after a closure triggered by regional security incidents. Aerospace Global News reported that the airport had resumed limited operations, but cautioned that reopening did not mean a return to normal operations. The report also said international airlines were maintaining flight suspensions.

The reopening does not guarantee that every airline has resumed flights or that published schedules will be maintained. Travellers may still face disruption, and the situation may change at short notice. The report advises passengers to check directly with the airline operating their flight rather than relying solely on a travel agent’s itinerary, an airport departure board or an older confirmation email.

zh.title: 漢莎航空規劃2027年8月開辦慕尼黑至鳳凰城每週三班航線
zh.summary: 漢莎航空規劃自2027年8月開辦慕尼黑至鳳凰城每週三班航線
body: Simple Flying報導，漢莎航空規劃自2027年8月起開辦慕尼黑至鳳凰城航班，每週三班。這是預定開辦的航線安排，摘要所列的航班將連接慕尼黑與鳳凰城，並非已開始營運的航班。
報導摘要指出，新增鳳凰城將使亞利桑那州納入漢莎航空航網，並將這項安排置於該航空公司擴展美國航網的脈絡中。摘要列出的計畫內容包括慕尼黑至鳳凰城航線、每週三班的頻率，以及2027年8月的預定開航時間。

en.title: Lufthansa Plans Three Weekly Munich–Phoenix Flights From August 2027
en.summary: Lufthansa plans three weekly Munich–Phoenix flights beginning in August 2027.
body: Simple Flying reports that Lufthansa plans to launch three weekly flights between Munich and Phoenix in August 2027. The report describes a future service plan, with Munich and Phoenix as the two cities and three flights per week as the planned frequency; it does not say that the service has already begun.

The report summary says the planned Phoenix service would add Arizona to Lufthansa’s network and forms part of the airline’s expansion across the United States. The stated plan identifies the city pair, the weekly frequency and August 2027 as the launch month. It describes a planned network addition rather than an operating service.

zh.title: WCC Aviation Holdings同意收購PhilJets Aero Services三成股權
zh.summary: WCC Aviation Holdings同意收購PhilJets Aero Services三成股權
body: WCC Aviation Holdings表示，已同意收購PhilJets Aero Services 30%股權。PhilJets Aero Services位於馬尼拉，提供商務噴射機與直升機服務。WCC Aviation Holdings於2026年10月20日宣佈這項協議；協議於10月15日由該公司總裁Dr. Raymond Patrick V. Guico與PhilJets董事長Thierry Tea簽署。
交易財務條件尚未公開。雙方計畫探討學生沉浸式體驗、導師指導、實務訓練及合格畢業生就業機會，並希望讓訓練更貼近業界需求，涵蓋飛行計畫、飛行派遣、維修程序與安全實務。PhilJets的飛機管理、包機、維修、技術服務、飛行派遣、行程支援及地面服務，也將納入WCC的航空業務組合。

en.title: WCC Aviation Holdings agrees to acquire 30% stake in PhilJets Aero Services
en.summary: WCC Aviation Holdings agreed to acquire a 30% stake in PhilJets Aero Services.
body: WCC Aviation Holdings said on October 20, 2026, that it had agreed to acquire a 30% stake in PhilJets Aero Services, a Manila-based provider of business jet and helicopter services. The agreement was signed on October 15 by WCC Aviation Holdings President Dr. Raymond Patrick V. Guico and PhilJets Chairman Thierry Tea.

Financial terms were not disclosed. The companies plan to explore student immersion, mentoring, practical training and job opportunities for qualified graduates, and aim to align training with industry needs in flight planning, flight dispatch, maintenance procedures and safety practices. PhilJets' services include aircraft management, charter flights, maintenance, technical services, flight dispatch, trip support and ground handling.
